name: Architecture
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of architecture to reveal profound spiritual truths about Christ and the Church. Ephesians 2:21-22 portrays believers as being fitly framed and built together into a holy temple, signifying our unity and growth as God's dwelling through the Spirit. Hebrews 3:3-4 emphasizes that while human builders construct houses, Christ is the supreme builder of all things, underscoring His divine authority and preeminence over the spiritual house He establishes.
